vocab.definition: absorbs heat (IR) — e.g. CO₂, methane, water vapour.
trapped heat keeps the Earth warm.
long-term change linked to rising greenhouse gases.
the total greenhouse gas a product/activity makes.

misconceptions.wrong: The greenhouse effect is always bad.
misconceptions.right: Some warming is essential for life on Earth.

misconceptions.wrong: The ozone hole causes global warming.
misconceptions.right: They are separate issues — warming is from greenhouse gases.

misconceptions.wrong: Weather and climate are the same.
misconceptions.right: Climate is the long-term average of weather.

questions.text: Explain how greenhouse gases keep the Earth warm. [3 marks]

footer.tip: Greenhouse gases absorb infrared and re-radiate it, trapping heat near the surface.
